 # Pricing
 
 Prices are stored in cents and rounded to the nearest cent.
+
+## Discount codes
+
+Codes are case-insensitive. Percent codes apply before rounding; fixed codes
+never take a total below zero."},{"sha":"d3a01669cac1db054847f602f5b2d89603d1b2a5","filename":"src/cart.ts","status":"modified","additions":7,"deletions":0,"changes":7,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/blob/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/src%2Fcart.ts","raw_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/raw/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/src%2Fcart.ts","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jettpbaker/pr-lab/contents/src%2Fcart.ts?ref=04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28","patch":"@@ -1,7 +1,14 @@
+import { applyDiscount, findDiscount } from './discount'
 import { add, money, type Money } from './money'
 
 export type Line = { sku: string; unit: Money; quantity: number }
 
 export function subtotal(lines: Line[]): Money {
   return lines.reduce((total, line) => add(total, money(line.unit.cents * line.quantity)), money(0))
 }
+
+export function total(lines: Line[], code?: string): Money {
+  const sum = subtotal(lines)
+  const discount = code ? findDiscount(code) : undefined
+  return discount ? applyDiscount(sum, discount) : sum
+}"},{"sha":"964cf6e5e73e4a6ee72348409b083fcdf64b44d7","filename":"src/discount.ts","status":"added","additions":20,"deletions":0,"changes":20,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/blob/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/src%2Fdiscount.ts","raw_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/raw/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/src%2Fdiscount.ts","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jettpbaker/pr-lab/contents/src%2Fdiscount.ts?ref=04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import { money, type Money } from './money'
+
+export type Discount =
+  | { kind: 'percent'; code: string; percent: number }
+  | { kind: 'fixed'; code: string; amount: Money }
+
+const codes = new Map<string, Discount>([
+  ['WELCOME10', { kind: 'percent', code: 'WELCOME10', percent: 10 }],
+  ['TEA5', { kind: 'fixed', code: 'TEA5', amount: money(500) }],
+])
+
+export function findDiscount(code: string): Discount | undefined {
+  return codes.get(code.trim().toUpperCase())
+}
+
+export function applyDiscount(total: Money, discount: Discount): Money {
+  const off =
+    discount.kind === 'percent' ? (total.cents * discount.percent) / 100 : discount.amount.cents
+  return money(Math.max(0, total.cents - off), total.currency)
+}"},{"sha":"928195da60087f4a519c39ca561590fb94d516c4","filename":"test/discount.test.ts","status":"added","additions":9,"deletions":0,"changes":9,"blob_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/blob/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/test%2Fdiscount.test.ts","raw_url":"https://github.com/jettpbaker/pr-lab/raw/04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28/test%2Fdiscount.test.ts","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jettpbaker/pr-lab/contents/test%2Fdiscount.test.ts?ref=04248ce587517ccb1f8ba8a0c7aa27932bad3d28","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+import { total } from '../src/cart'
+import { money } from '../src/money'
+
+const lines = [{ sku: 'tea', unit: money(2000), quantity: 1 }]
+
+test('applies a percent code', () => expect(total(lines, 'welcome10').cents).toBe(1800))
+test('applies a fixed code', () => expect(total(lines, 'TEA5').cents).toBe(1500))
+test('ignores unknown codes', () => expect(total(lines, 'NOPE').cents).toBe(2000))"}]
